findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Creative styles" above "Jump-start your next idea"; "Gallery" above "Artwork generated with GlowUp AI"; "Features" above "Everything you need to create"; "How it works" above "Your imagination, in three simple steps."; "Made with GlowUp AI" above "A little inspiration goes a long way."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 9 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Creative styles", "Gallery", "Features", "How it works").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 15 gradient fill(s): div.pointer-events-none.absolute → radial-gradient(rgba(255, 251, 225, 0.72) 0%, rgba(255, 251, 225, 0.38) 36%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%) | div.relative.border-y → linear-gradient(oklab(0.999994 0.0000455677 0.0000200868 / 0.8) 0%, oklab(0.999994 0.0000455678 0.0000200868 / | button.group.relative → linear-gradient(rgb(255, 255, 255) 0%, rgb(246, 246, 248) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 6 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.relative.border-y 1440px | section#features.relative.scroll-mt-24 1440px | section#how-it-works.relative.scroll-mt-24 1440px | footer.border-t.border-border/60 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 15 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #fffbe1).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Indigo / violet (text #8b5cf6).
findings.fix: Use the accent from the drawn palette.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "Fantasy" 1.9:1 (#f4a7c5 on #ffffff); "Ready" 2.5:1 (#10b981 on #ffffff)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Inter, Manrope, Inter Tight).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 13 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: The margins differ: 112px on the left, 72px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 7 different lines (112px, 225px, 529px, 557px, 985px, 141px, 973px); the three most used hold only 50% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 16px at 768px. Widest offenders: canvas.pointer-events-none.absolute (+16px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Generate multiple images and r" (8px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
